Senses.Explanation: Karmic consciousness is the busy, unsettled discriminating activity speakers call (茫茫), (忙忙), or (紛沉掉). The compound names that conditioned bustle and lack of footing in these passages; it is narrower than consciousness in general and must not absorb every use of mind.
